brief:
Israeli occupation forces raided the home of al-Eizariya's deputy mayor and assaulted him, the Ma'an news agency reported. Details of the incident, including the timing and extent of injuries, were not immediately available.

The raid is part of ongoing military operations in Palestinian communities near Jerusalem. Al-Eizariya, located east of the city, has experienced repeated Israeli incursions in recent months.
title: Israeli forces raid deputy mayor's home, beat him in al-Eizariya
